integrity: The proof uses an exact one-step covariance recurrence, a closed unary formula and a rigorous Cesàro limit; a standalone finite verifier is provided, with no claim that finite enumeration proves infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Rooted, uniform-parent recursive trees only; the geometric covariance limit holds for each fixed outdegree, not uniformly across growing degrees. No independent historical-priority certification; the existing leaf special case is credited to prior work.
title: A twenty-two-vertex sign reversal and geometric root–degree-profile covariance in random recursive trees
